name: @audiolens/gui-headless
description: AudioLens #131: headless-verifiable GUI integration layer — product theme, screen compositions built on vendored @ruviform ui/{core,components,binding} controls, and the BindingPort gateway that translates control gestures/commands/queries into AlGuiService ops. Test-only deps; the layer itself is plain TS + DOM-standard APIs, framework-neutral.
